name: GPT Token
fix_description: In transfer, the fee logic is inverted for swap pair transfers: when to is a swap pair (selling), NO fee is charged; when to is NOT a pair (regular transfer), fee IS charged. This allows fee-free selling to the pair while buys from the pair may still incur fees, creating an exploitable price discrepancy. Fix by charging fee when to == pair (sells) and optionally when from == pair (buys).
difficulty_reasoning: This is a multi-step exploit involving five nested flash loans, AMM pair state manipulation via sync/skim, and understanding a broken fee-on-transfer token interaction with PancakeSwap mechanics. While the core bug is conceptually simple once identified, writing the PoC requires protocol-specific reasoning across several contracts and more than a trivial call sequence.
